EXCEPTION TYPES MISSED
a) ValueError from CPython int-string digit limit (4300 digits, CVE-2020-10735 mitigation).
   json.loads('{"input_tokens": ' + '9'*5000 + '}') raises ValueError: Exceeds the limit (4300 digits) for integer string conversion
   Source: PRIOR_TASK.md lines 26-29 (initial task claim; confirmed by RED test above)
b) RecursionError from deeply-nested JSON arrays.
   Executed stderr: 'RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while decoding a JSON array from a unicode string'
   Source: PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md lines 44-46

IMPACT (initial task claim, PRIOR_TASK.md lines 38-41, not independently re-executed)
  cost_tracker.py:517 loops parse_trace() over every agent_trace.jsonl with no per-trace guard;
  one corrupt line in one trace kills cost reporting for the entire batch.
  Reporter assessment: robustness bug (P1), not a security issue (internal harness, no attacker boundary).

FIX VERIFIED GREEN (executed, PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md lines 66-78)
  catch (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, RecursionError) at both sites.
  After fix: 177 passed in 0.27s on Python 3.12.6.
  Task status at capture time: OPEN (no commit/merge evidence supplied).

CALLER RECOVERY / ERROR CONTRACT
  At parse boundaries handling third-party/harness trace input, catching only json.JSONDecodeError
  is insufficient on Python 3.11+ (CPython int-string limit added then). Must also catch ValueError
  and RecursionError to match the documented 'skip malformed lines' contract.

LIMITS AND CONDITIONAL TRANSFER
  - Python version in evidence: 3.12.6 only. 4300-digit limit is present since Python 3.11.
  - Only these two call sites confirmed. Other json.loads sites in the project not inspected.
  - Generalisation to other projects: unknown — record this as a pattern to CHECK, not assume.
  - Merge/commit status: unknown; task was still OPEN when this evidence was captured.
